passage.text: Thank you for your assignment about your hometown.
passage.reading: ˈθæŋk juː fər jʊr əˈsaɪnmənt əˈbaʊt jʊr ˈhoʊmtaʊn.

passage.text: Your ideas are interesting, and your first paragraph is very good.
passage.reading: jʊr aɪˈdiːəz ər ˈɪntrəstɪŋ, ənd jʊr ˈfɜːrst ˈpærəɡræf ɪz ˈvɛri ˈɡʊd.

passage.text: Your vocabulary has improved a lot.
passage.reading: jʊr voʊˈkæbjəlɛri hæz ɪmˈpruːvd ə ˈlɑːt.

passage.text: For example, you wrote "their" when you meant "there".
passage.reading: fər ɪɡˈzæmpəl, juː ˈroʊt ˈðɛr wɛn juː ˈmɛnt ˈðɛr.

passage.text: Your punctuation needs some work, too.
passage.reading: jʊr ˌpʌŋktʃuˈeɪʃən ˈniːdz sʌm ˈwɜːrk, ˈtuː.

passage.text: Some of your sentences are very long, so try to write shorter ones.
passage.reading: sʌm əv jʊr ˈsɛntənsɪz ər ˈvɛri ˈlɔːŋ, soʊ ˈtraɪ tə ˈraɪt ˈʃɔːrtər wʌnz.

passage.text: Your next assignment is about your favorite food.
passage.reading: jʊr ˈnɛkst əˈsaɪnmənt ɪz əˈbaʊt jʊr ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈfuːd.

passage.text: Please send it to me by Friday.
passage.reading: ˈpliːz ˈsɛnd ɪt tə miː baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ.
